rules.freshness: Target = twice the run interval of the workflow that writes the file when it runs daily or more often, the interval plus 2 days when it runs weekly or monthly, plus 1 day when the file states only a date (counted from 00:00 UTC). Age = now minus the timestamp the file itself states (or, without one, the time of the last commit that published it). No target for files written by hand, on demand or after events. The Parquet files also count as fresh while they were built from the current bali-cases.json.
rules.contracts: Each JSON file is validated against its JSON Schema (2020-12) in /data/schemas/kolaboro-data.schema.json. The contracts were written from the files as published on 5 Nov 2026: every top-level key is required with its type, items of top-level lists and maps must keep the keys every item had, numbers are "number", deeper optional values may be null. Parquet files are checked against the columns and row count in kolaboro.parquet.json, tiles and screenshots against their binary headers. API answers are validated against the response schemas in /docs/api/openapi.json, which were inferred from live responses.
rules.sizes_hashes: Bytes and SHA-256 are of the exact bytes https://kolaboro.com/data/ served to the job. A tile set has one SHA-256 over the sorted "sha256  path" lines of its files.

datasets.title: Tracked off-plan projects (anonymous)
datasets.description: Every off-plan project Kolaboro tracks, one record per anonymous project id: market, country, stage, price band, promised handover year, the six public checks (permit, deposit protection, progress, plans, track record, no guaranteed returns), how far each is confirmed, claims tested, flags and the change history. Advertised claims, not verified facts. The same data is served filtered by /api/open/projects.
datasets.schedule: twice a month (1st and 15th, 06:17 UTC) and every time the research files change

datasets.title: What developers advertise, by market
datasets.description: Per market: how many tracked projects, title and lease terms advertised, guaranteed-return language, permit claims, permit numbers and plans published, and advertised USD prices. Aggregates only.
datasets.schedule: twice a month (1st and 15th, 06:17 UTC) and every time the research files change

datasets.title: What developers advertise in Bali
datasets.description: The same aggregate as world-claims for the Bali market alone: title and lease terms, guaranteed-return language, permit claims and numbers, plans and advertised prices.
datasets.schedule: twice a month (1st and 15th, 06:17 UTC) and every time the research files change

datasets.title: Projects table (Parquet)
datasets.description: One row per tracked project, built from bali-cases.json: checks, confirmation levels, claims, delay, satellite status and page fingerprint, in Apache Parquet for DuckDB, pandas or Spark. Columns and row count are listed in kolaboro.parquet.json.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Thursday 07:43 UTC, and after each research run; rewritten only when the source changed

datasets.title: Markets table (Parquet)
datasets.description: One row per market with the same method as /api/open/markets: projects, average public and confirmed checks, permit and deposit-protection shares, flags and the transparency index.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Thursday 07:43 UTC, and after each research run; rewritten only when the source changed

datasets.title: Parquet export manifest
datasets.description: Columns, row counts, sizes and SHA-256 of the two Parquet files and the SHA-256 of the bali-cases.json they were built from. A signed copy is served by /api/x/e/parquet-manifest.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Thursday 07:43 UTC, and after each research run; rewritten only when the source changed

datasets.title: Live findings from developer pages
datasets.description: Once a day our agent re-reads the developer pages of the tracked projects that were checked longest ago and publishes a finding only when a fact (handover date, price, permit number) is new or changed, with the SHA-256 of the exact quote, checked word for word in code. Anonymous: project id and market only. AI spend is capped at 0.25 USD a day for all runs together (until 6 Nov 2026 the job ran every hour on a larger budget).

datasets.title: Live findings per project
datasets.description: Per project id: when the daily page check last read the developer page (fp = first 16 hex of the SHA-256 of the page text) and its findings, newest first. Same rules as live-findings.json.

datasets.title: Dated developer promises
datasets.description: Every dated promise a developer made about a tracked project (handover, construction start, structure, other milestones, permits, rental programme), read from the research records, with its status today. Per project and per market.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Wednesday 11:23 UTC, and after each research run

datasets.title: Promise drift on developer pages
datasets.description: Day by day, which advertised values changed on each tracked developer page (handover date, prices, units and other fields), from fingerprinted page text. No URLs or names.
datasets.schedule: monthly, on the 16th at 09:43 UTC, and after each research run

datasets.title: Website age of project pages
datasets.description: For each project whose page is on its own website: domain registration date (RDAP) and earliest TLS certificate (Certificate Transparency), at month precision. No domains are published.
datasets.schedule: monthly, on the 16th at 09:43 UTC, and after each research run

datasets.title: Delivery delay index
datasets.description: How far tracked off-plan projects are behind the first handover date on record, by market, with rules, caveats and monthly history.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Thursday 16:37 UTC, monthly snapshot on the 1st, and after each research run

datasets.title: On-time handover odds
datasets.description: For each project: will it hand over within 6 months of the first date on record? Estimated from closed comparable projects with a 95% interval, plus validation and the bias of the sample.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Thursday 16:37 UTC, monthly snapshot on the 1st, and after each research run

datasets.title: Asking-price index
datasets.description: Chained index of advertised asking prices ("from" prices on developer and listing pages) per market, with daily snapshots, rules and caveats. Not transaction prices.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Wednesday 14:41 UTC, and after each research run

datasets.title: Advertised versus registered prices
datasets.description: Advertised starting prices compared with officially registered sales where a government publishes them: counts, quartiles and medians only, converted to USD at a cited rate. Lists the markets not covered.

datasets.title: Risk patterns
datasets.description: Which tracked projects look unusual on public warning signs compared with all others, and why, with a model card. It ranks; it does not predict. No project has a confirmed outcome to train on.

datasets.title: Official register checks
datasets.description: Every official register linked on /registers/: whether our checker could read it (time, HTTP status, size and SHA-256 of the bytes received), and per project the register result, with a hash-chained lookup archive.

datasets.title: Company and director graph (UK)
datasets.description: Anonymised company and director graph for tracked projects whose developer is a UK company found on Companies House by exact name. Counts and anonymised nodes only.

datasets.title: Global company graph (GLEIF)
datasets.description: For each tracked project: whether the companies named as developer have a Legal Entity Identifier, their parents and countries, as counts and booleans only. Source GLEIF (CC0).

datasets.title: Insolvency watch
datasets.description: Daily check of UK and Spanish developer companies against insolvency notices (The Gazette, BORME). Each hit is reduced to date, source and type of notice; no company names.

datasets.title: Spanish insolvency index (hashed)
datasets.description: Insolvency acts published in BORME Section One, keyed by a truncated SHA-256 of the normalised company name so the file is not a readable list of companies; anyone can test a name against it. Source BOE, reuse with attribution.

datasets.title: Natural hazards at tracked projects
datasets.description: Elevation, flood depth, earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanoes and coastline distance for tracked projects with coordinates and watched areas, rounded so they cannot pinpoint a plot. Sources listed in the file.

datasets.title: Satellite watch (Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1)
datasets.description: Sentinel-2 vegetation and clearing per season and Sentinel-1 radar backscatter change for every watched site and area (boxes of about 1 km). Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

datasets.title: Monthly optical progress series
datasets.description: Per watched site and month from January 2023: cloud-masked Sentinel-2 median, built_pct (built-up or bare ground, which look alike at 10 m) and new built-up since the baseline month. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

datasets.title: Stalled construction sites
datasets.description: Sentinel-2 change between clear quarters in a 150 m window around every project with coordinates, and which sites show almost no change.

datasets.title: Night lights at finished projects
datasets.description: NASA Black Marble night-time light at projects that should be finished, compared with the surrounding ring, monthly for 36 months. Light is a proxy, not proof of occupancy.

datasets.title: Visual changes on developer pages
datasets.description: Where the pages of tracked developer websites visibly changed, as page geometry only. No screenshots are published, because they would copy the developers' own copyrighted images.

datasets.title: Reused renders across projects
datasets.description: Pairs of images that appear on the pages of two different tracked projects on different domains (CLIP image embeddings, cosine 0.85 or more, confirmed by feature matching), with what was excluded and why.

datasets.title: Perceptual image hashes
datasets.description: 64-bit difference hashes of the images kept by the weekly render-reuse run, so anyone can check whether a picture appears on a tracked project page.

datasets.title: Render index
datasets.description: Perceptual hashes of images found on the websites the research agent reads, used to check whether a picture a buyer was sent also appears elsewhere.

datasets.title: Similar projects
datasets.description: For every public project, the 5 most similar other public projects: ids and rounded scores only (text similarity from an open sentence-embedding model run on the GitHub runner, plus structured similarity). Input is only the public bali-cases.json.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Tuesday 02:23 UTC, and after each research run

datasets.title: Market points for the map
datasets.description: One public point per market (not per project), from Natural Earth and GeoNames, used to place anonymous projects on the map. Private per-project coordinates are never used.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Tuesday 02:23 UTC, and after each research run

datasets.title: Change heatmap
datasets.description: Day by day, the last published bali-cases.json of each day compared with the previous day's copy: new projects, page edits (page fingerprint changed), price band moves, date moves and register changes, counted per market over rolling windows. A project counts once per kind and market in a window.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Monday 06:23 UTC, and when the digest code changes

datasets.title: Weekly market digest
datasets.description: Per ISO week: new projects, changes and alerts by market, built from the public bali-cases, promises, register-checks and stalled-sites files. An AI model may draft only the intro paragraph, and code checks every number in it.
datasets.schedule: weekly, Monday 06:23 UTC, and when the digest code changes

datasets.title: Mystery shopper programme
datasets.description: Questionnaire, measurement rules and status of the mystery shopper programme. It has not started; the file says why.

datasets.title: Product roadmap
datasets.description: The public product roadmap: each item with its number, theme, title, short description and status.

datasets.title: Fictional sample score
datasets.description: One fictional project (marked fictional: true) used to demonstrate the score page. Not real data.

datasets.title: Sample photo progress analysis
datasets.description: One stored example answer of the photo progress check, used on the demo page.

datasets.title: Coastline outline tiles
datasets.description: Natural Earth 1:10m land outline (public domain, via world-atlas 2.0.2) cut into 10 degree tiles (published as one file per 10 degree column of longitude), quantised and delta-encoded, used by the hazards check only when no OpenStreetMap server answers. Every tile exists; open-ocean tiles are empty.
datasets.sha256_of: the sorted list of "sha256  path" lines, one per file (sha256sum format)
datasets.download_hint: One file per tile: coast/-10.json, coast/-100.json, coast/-110.json ...

datasets.title: Mangrove index tiles
datasets.description: Global Mangrove Watch v3 (2020) reduced to cells of about 220 m that contain any mangrove pixel, in binary 45 degree blocks (format GMW1, see the file header description in the protected-land endpoint). Source CC BY 4.0, Bunting et al. 2022.
datasets.schedule: static, rebuilt once per Global Mangrove Watch release
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Global Mangrove Watch v3, Bunting et al. 2022; credit Kolaboro for the reduction)
datasets.sha256_of: the sorted list of "sha256  path" lines, one per file (sha256sum format)
datasets.download_hint: One file per tile: mangroves/-135_-45.bin, mangroves/-135_0.bin, mangroves/-180_-45.bin ...

datasets.title: AI desk review benchmark
datasets.description: Results of the desk review benchmark on fixed fictional cases, one file per model (Haiku, Sonnet), each case answer signed with the Kolaboro Ed25519 key.
datasets.sha256_of: the sorted list of "sha256  path" lines, one per file (sha256sum format)
datasets.download_hint: One file per item: benchmark/haiku.json, benchmark/sonnet.json ...

datasets.title: Accessibility audit
datasets.description: axe-core audit of every page (WCAG 2.2 AA rules) with counts per rule and page and the run history.

datasets.title: Lighthouse scores
datasets.description: Lighthouse runs per page and form factor with thresholds and flags.

datasets.title: Site QA crawl
datasets.description: Daily crawl of every page and link with the checks that ran and any problems found.

datasets.title: Synthetic user journeys
datasets.description: A scripted buyer journey run in a real browser every week: pass or fail per step, timings and the latest screenshots (journeys/1.webp to 5.webp).

datasets.title: Independent verifier run
datasets.description: Three independent implementations (JavaScript, Python, Go) check the test vectors and the live log, checkpoint, proofs and signatures.

datasets.title: Chaos drills
datasets.description: Weekly fault-injection drills of the desk review (for example the primary AI reader down): what was forced, what was expected, what happened, and what is not covered.

datasets.title: Security scan
datasets.description: OWASP ZAP baseline passive scan of kolaboro.com: alerts by risk.

datasets.title: Backup restore drill
datasets.description: Weekly drill: the latest database backup is restored into a clean PostgreSQL and checked table by table, and evidence files are re-hashed.

datasets.title: Deploy guard record
datasets.description: Each deploy of the site: smoke checks after it went live, and any automatic rollback.
datasets.schedule: after each site deploy (event driven, plus a daily check at 06:37 UTC)

datasets.title: Site manifest
datasets.description: SHA-256 of every file published on kolaboro.com outside /data/, computed from the git commit the live site was serving.
datasets.schedule: checked weekly (Monday 04:23 UTC), written when the live commit changes

datasets.title: Reproducible worker builds
datasets.description: Deterministic bundle of the site worker for each worker source tree that went live, built twice in clean folders; reproduced says whether both builds were identical.
datasets.schedule: checked weekly (Monday 04:23 UTC), written when the worker changes

datasets.title: Property-based tests of the scoring rules
datasets.description: Property-based tests and fuzzing of the open scoring rules, counted by the test run itself.
datasets.schedule: published when the open-source test suite is run

datasets.title: Shipping log
datasets.description: Ships (commits by people, or by Claude working for one) and data updates per UTC day from the git history of the live branch, streaks, engineering metrics and day summaries written by an AI model and checked in code.

datasets.title: Roadmap items verified live
datasets.description: Roadmap items that link to the live page delivering them. An item counts as shipped only when the page answers HTTP 200, its canonical link is that page and its HTML contains the marker text.

datasets.title: Page weight
datasets.description: Bytes transferred for one cold load of key pages (compressed size plus headers, measured in Chrome), first-party bytes split by resource type, against page-weight budgets.

datasets.title: Visual regression tests
datasets.description: Key pages captured in Chromium at 390 and 1440 px and compared pixel by pixel with the previous run, with the share of changed pixels per page.
